item.title: New Report: How Wellness Is Reshaping Hotel Development and Management
item.description: Wellness has shifted from a desirable add-on to an essential value driver for the hospitality sector. Peloton’s new report reveals how high-impact wellness design, programming, and technology are now shaping guest decision-making and outlines what hospitality executives must do to stay ahead.

item.title: Exclusive Resorts Wins Fight for Inspirato in $59 Million Deal
item.description: There was too much logic to keep this Exclusive Resorts-Inspirato merger from taking place. And there was too much illogic in Inspirato's abandoned combination with car marketplace Buyerlink.

item.title: Famous vs. Indispensable: The Choice AI Is Forcing on OTAs
item.description: Expedia and Booking are trying to be both the storefront and the supply chain. AI is squeezing the middle, and “doing both” starts to look less like diversification and more like diluted power.

item.title: Japan Could See Big Financial Hit as Chinese Tourist Numbers Cool
item.description: Chinese travelers tend to be big spenders in Japan, so Japanese tourism officials are surely eager for Tokyo and Beijing to find ways to defuse the tensions between the two countries quickly before the industry — and the economy — takes a major hit.

item.title: Airbnb Passed, Expedia Pounced: Inside Tiqets’ Long Road to a Sale: Scoop
item.description: That Airbnb didn't acquire Tiqets for its own experiences business after leading a Series C funding round, didn't give Tiqets much street cred. The Expedia deal couldn't have been a very substantial one for investors given the lack of financial disclosures.

item.title: Building Brands vs. AI’s Cheap Wins: How Hilton’s CMO Strikes the Balance
item.description: Hotel groups must ensure that short-term performance marketing doesn’t quietly erode brand loyalty, which may be key to unlocking bookings driven by agentic AI.

item.title: Air Pollution and Extreme Fog Disrupt Flights in Delhi Amid Peak Tourism Season
item.description: Airlines and governments are being forced to adapt to Dehli's worsening winter pollution as visibility drops.

item.title: Trump Administration Looks to Ramp Up Flying Taxis
item.description: As China makes more advances on flying taxis, the Trump administration is hoping it can speed up the U.S. effort. The biggest startups hope for a 2026 debut.

item.title: Delta President Glen Hauenstein to Retire After Leading Premium Push
item.description: Hauenstein played a pivotal role in Delta’s premium push, which has made Delta one of the most profitable airlines in the U.S.

item.title: How Live Tourism Fueled India’s Travel Industry This Year
item.description: What started as revenge travel post Covid has now changed into Indians taking every event and turning into an opportunity to travel.
